# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-06-14

## Codex CLI 0.139.0 (mid-June 2026) — minor, not reportable
- Code mode can call standalone web search directly; tool input schemas now preserve `oneOf`/`allOf` structures; enhanced `codex doctor` (environment details); plugin marketplace automation gains JSON output.
- (2026-06-14: incremental dev-tool refinements; no new entity/API/attack surface. Below the reporting bar.)

## June 11, 2026 — Codex app 26.609
- **Developer Mode for Browser Use**: controlled **Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)** access enabling performance profiling and deeper debugging of "network traffic, console output, runtime errors, and page state" in both Chrome and the in-app browser.
- **`/init` command**: create project instructions using the same initialization workflow available in the CLI.
- **Computer Use for Enterprise**: extended Computer Use to Enterprise users in regions outside the EEA, UK, and Switzerland (availability/geo expansion).
- **Windows App Access Controls**: per-application access configuration for Computer Use on Windows devices (governance control).
- **Rate-Limit Banking & Referrals**: Plus/Pro users can bank rate-limit resets; one complimentary reset at launch + referral credits.
- **Unread Chats** section in the command menu.
- Browser-use performance: "up to 2x faster" via CDP and DOM-snapshot optimizations reducing browser round trips.
- (Reported 2026-06-12 — ENDPOINT/AIRT MEDIUM: Developer Mode browser CDP access = new agent browser-control & inspection surface.)
- Docs: https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/chrome-extension

## June 9, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.153 + Worktree/setup-script capability [reported 2026-06-10]
- iOS app added: branch selection, worktree creation, environment setup scripts, a Codex profile screen with usage statistics, and the `/goal` command.
- Worktree creation can optionally run a local environment's setup scripts automatically at thread start (arbitrary command execution).
- Docs: https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/worktrees ; https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/local-environments

## June 8, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.138.0 [reported 2026-06-09]
- Desktop handoff from CLI to Codex app on macOS and Windows; local image paths exposed to models; enhanced reasoning-effort shortcuts.

## June 4, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.137.0 [reported 2026-06-05/08]
- Hosted web/image tools in code-mode flows, parallel web search; multi-agent v2; remote-control pairing/controller grants.

## June 4, 2026 — Codex App 26.602 [reported 2026-06-05]
- Activity insights and share cards added to Profile section.

## June 2, 2026 — Sites plugin (preview) [reported 2026-06-03]
## June 2, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.146 [reported 2026-06-03]
## June 1, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.136.0 [reported 2026-06-02] — Amazon Bedrock support
